label: Уважаемый
description: A 10-sentence card for уважаемый, the present passive participle of уважать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Уважаемый comes from уважать — the first-conjugation form уважаем plus -ый. It agrees with masculine профессор and means the respected one, also a standard letter salutation.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The feminine ending -ая lets уважаемая agree with гостья. The -ем- suffix marks the first conjugation, and the word names the honoured guest.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Уважаемое carries the neuter ending -ое to match мнение. As a present passive participle it means the opinion that is respected.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ые lets уважаемые agree with коллеги. This form has lexicalized as a fixed polite address meaning dear colleagues.
Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the animate masculine object врача the participle takes -ого, so уважаемого agrees as the doctor I know. Уважаемый врач equals врач, которого уважают.
Strategic focus: Masculine genitive. Уважаемого takes the masculine genitive ending to agree with учёного, marking the respected scholar as the source of the words.
Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative noun судье pulls уважаемому into the dative -ому ending. The word names the esteemed judge who receives the letter.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental. After стала the predicate человеком stands in the instrumental, and уважаемым takes the matching instrumental ending to agree with it.
Strategic focus: Feminine prepositional. The preposition об governs the prepositional case, so женщине and уважаемой both take prepositional endings as the respected woman we discuss.

Strategic focus: Plural lexicalization. Уважаемые here is a polite adjective meaning dear, formed from уважаем with -ые. It agrees with plural читатели and shows the participle settled into everyday formulas.
